plugin.name: Novel Reader
status.saveFailed: Save failed; the bookshelf or reading progress may not be preserved
status.loadFailed: Failed to load the saved state; changes will be kept in a recovery snapshot
status.panelUnavailable: This host version does not support opening plugin panels
empty.books: No books yet. Click "Import TXT" to start.
empty.chapters: No chapters detected; the text is split into fixed-length segments.
win.hint: The reader window lives while this plugin panel stays open. Drag the top bar to move it.
settings.script.hint: Converts text character by character (with a common two-character word table). With "follow app language": a Simplified UI converts to Simplified, a Traditional UI to Traditional, other languages keep the original.
settings.tipKeys: Bindings are customizable under "Key bindings" below; the paging scope is controlled above.
keys.hint: Click a binding button, then press the new key combo; Esc cancels, Backspace / Delete clears it.
settings.tipAltWheel: Hold Alt and scroll on the reader window to adjust opacity quickly.
settings.clearConfirm: This deletes all books, reading progress and imported sources (settings and shortcuts are kept). It cannot be undone. Continue?
data.storage: Book texts are stored locally in IndexedDB (falling back to the plugin private store); sources, reading progress and settings live in the plugin private store and are never uploaded. Storage used is estimated from the imported file sizes.
source.title: Sources
source.importHint: Paste a Legado book-source JSON, or pick a .json file. @css:, XPath and JSONPath rules are supported; rules using JS / webView are ignored.
source.importModalHint: Accepts a single book source or a collection (JSON array / {bookSources:[...]}); multiple sources can be imported at once.
source.empty: No sources yet. Import a Legado book-source JSON to search and read online.
source.importOverwrite: Overwrite sources with the same URL (keeps the enabled/disabled state)
source.importEmpty: No valid source found (bookSourceUrl is required)
source.warn.title: Some rules in this source are unsupported and may fail:
source.searchEmpty: No results. Try another keyword or source.
source.searchNoSource: No usable book source yet. Import and enable sources on the Sources tab first.
source.encodingWarn: This site declares {{charset}} encoding, but the content could not be decoded with it; the text may be garbled.
source.deleteConfirm: Click Delete again to remove this source
source.contentEmpty: No content extracted for this chapter. The rules may not match, or the site changed.
source.exactHint: Only show results whose title or author is exactly what you searched; similar ones are hidden.
source.exactEmpty: No title or author exactly matches your search. Turn off Exact match to see similar results.
err.network: Network request failed. Check your connection and try again.
err.timeout: Request timed out; the site responded too slowly.
err.netUnavailable: This host version does not support network requests.
err.invalidResponse: The site returned content that could not be parsed.
err.sourceMissing: This source was deleted. Import it again on the Sources tab.
err.noBookUrl: This result has no book URL, so it cannot be added.
err.emptyToc: No chapter list was parsed; the source rules may not match the site.
err.allFailed: All sources failed. Check your network or switch sources.
err.unknown: Request failed. Try again later or switch sources.
status.clearedAll: All data cleared (including sources and cache)
data.cacheHint: Chapter text is cached in memory and keeps the {{max}} most recently used chapters; deleting a source or clearing all data also clears it.
